licence.note: Once per spawn (index.mjs). Configuration only (policy=, shared=, minraise=); the base 0fe92258 never writes the kind. Every canary bot must read policy=1 shared=1 (isolated pools are never drawn). The effective state is pf= on each _well_pit_dug.

require.name: a town building or holding a raised junk well (plan, complete-awaiting-well, or no well)

draw_exposure.note: TODO coordinator: after the 0fe92258 rollout most no-well towns are mid-plinth; re-measure eligibility at queue time. Isolated pools are never drawn (drawrequire.py); exclude them from the CONTROL too (Claude r2/r3: strata must match).

exposure.note: fixes_exposed = canary rows of any of: _well_refused reason=well_site_held, _plinth stage=planned why=trigger_*, _well_refused reason=no_site tally=cols:0,plinth_first:1 rec=ok. POLICY exposure is reported separately as policy_exposed = canary no_site rows with shadow=<x,y,z> (a natural cell declined); expected 0 -> the policy delta is labelled UNEXPOSED and recorded INCONCLUSIVE for the policy, read again on the first natural-well break after promotion. KEEP rests on the plinth2read/wellread lines and the tripwires below, never on the policy.

own_lines.note: A canary _well_pit_dug from=fresh pf=1 at a cap that is not a plinth cap (rows + records): a NEW natural well under the policy. pf=0 fallback starts (the 24 h none window) are reported separately, never counted.

A canary _plinth stage=planned why=trigger_complete_lost_no_evidence: every no-site record over a finished cap now carries evidence; one without means a missed path. Skip known other-build rows (restart lag).
A canary _plinthfirst_mode row with shared=0 or policy=0 (a mis-drawn or mis-configured canary bot). Blocks KEEP.
C6: two wells in one town (the plinth-first trigger beside a natural pit would show here).

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: canary vs control, pre vs post -- well_site_held rows, complete_lost replans by evidence class (structural / persisted / no_evidence), plinth orders suppressed by dy, plans by k (expect k>=2), policy_exposed. Tripwires are counted over EVERY canary town, not only the drawn population (Claude r3).

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control (immobiledid).

teardown.note: THREE STEPS (drop-ins, canary_pool, restart 12 s apart; confirm two versions). Records the canary wrote (caprefused notes, plannedFor/minK fields, a no-site record's lost=) are ignored by the base.

extension.note: fixes_exposed is reachable in any town holding a plinth; policy_exposed is not expected (see exposure).
